release_notes_zh:
新增
- 新增自动检查更新、自动下载安装包与覆盖安装
- 新增裁剪与导出统一入口，支持 MKT 与 LabChart
- 新增标注统计：段数、累计时长、占比
- 新增正式中文安装包、许可协议和项目文档

改进
- 统一模型列表，仅保留 Falcon、Heron、Osprey、Swift 四个正式模型
- 统一模型描述与界面文案
- 优化波形缩放、后台导出和 AI 预标注

修复
- 修复 Y 轴缩小卡在 0.4 的问题
- 修复左键框选时视图自动移动的问题
- 修复导出对话框长时间占用界面的问题

注意事项
- 覆盖安装会保留 %APPDATA%\TrueRespi 中的用户数据
- 安装包未做商业代码签名，SmartScreen 提示时请核对 SHA256
release_notes_en:
New
- Automatic update check, background download and in-place upgrade
- Unified crop/export entry for MKT and LabChart
- Annotation statistics: segments, duration and coverage
- Chinese installer, EULA and project documentation

Improved
- Curated model list: Falcon, Heron, Osprey and Swift only
- Unified model and UI descriptions
- Faster waveform zoom, background export and AI pre-annotation

Fixed
- Y-axis zoom-out getting stuck at 0.4
- Viewport auto-panning during left-drag selection
- Export dialog blocking the workspace

Notes
- In-place upgrade preserves user data under %APPDATA%\TrueRespi
- The installer is not commercially code-signed; verify SHA256 if SmartScreen warns
